scripts.render:orb-backdrop: remotion render OrbBackdrop ../assets/video/orb-backdrop-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i ../assets/video/orb-backdrop-raw.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]trim=start=4,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[a];[0:v]trim=duration=4,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[b];[a][b]xfade=transition=fade:duration=4:offset=20[v]" -map "[v]" -c:v libx264 -crf 28 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart ../assets/video/orb-backdrop.mp4 && rm ../assets/video/orb-backdrop-raw.mp4
scripts.render:cinema-hero: remotion render CinemaHero ../assets/video/cinema-hero-raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i ../assets/video/cinema-hero-raw.mp4 -filter_complex "[0:v]trim=start=2,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[a];[0:v]trim=duration=2,setpts=PTS-STARTPTS[b];[a][b]xfade=transition=fade:duration=2:offset=22[v]" -map "[v]" -c:v libx264 -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p ../assets/video/cinema-hero.mp4 && rm ../assets/video/cinema-hero-raw.mp4
scripts.render:process: npm run manifest && remotion render ProcessReel ../assets/video/process-reel.mp4
scripts.render:process:gif: npm run manifest && remotion render ProcessReel ../assets/video/process-reel.gif --codec=gif --every-nth-frame=2
